subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: Which public reset-start policy should OpenClaw support for bare `/new` and `/reset` across chat handlers, Gateway `agent`, prompt text, startup context, and optional model routing?
rationale: The request adds compatibility-sensitive config and model-routing behavior while current main intentionally ships acknowledgement-only resets and related reports ask to restore model turns, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Define one reset-start policy
options.body: Create one typed policy that covers ack-only, startup-turn, prompt customization, and optional model override, then update schema, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Keep ack-only default with opt-in greeting
options.body: Preserve the shipped cheap reset behavior while exposing an explicit mode for persona workflows that need a model greeting.

options.title: Defer new config
options.body: Keep current static acknowledgements and let prompt customization or startup-turn restoration proceed only after maintainers sponsor the broader contract.

recommendation.title: Define one reset-start policy
recommendation.body: Create one typed policy that covers ack-only, startup-turn, prompt customization, and optional model override, then update schema, docs, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans the shipped acknowledgement branch, config compatibility, Gateway reset behavior, and prior reset-contract review history most directly tied to this handle.
